I added the `owes <member>` command (R1) and the rule that a member owing more than 5.00 can't borrow (R2); all 23 tests pass and the work is committed.
I did not implement R3 (staff are never refused except at their loan limit) because it conflicts with R2, L01-R2 (suspension) and DEC-005 (holds). Following the README, staff follow the same rules as everyone else for now.
That conflict is recorded as an open question for Head of Lending and Staff Services in `.work/report.json`.
